Tag.ja: 魚のベジタリアンの餌

CardDescription.DefaultText:
Should place bait on its hook if I want to have a chance at catching anything.

You can sometimes find bugs by clearing areas.
CardDescription.Text: 如果我想抓到什么就得放上诱饵。偶尔能在清理区域时找到虫子。
CardDescription.zh: 如果我想抓到什么就得放上诱饵。偶尔能在清理区域时找到虫子。
CardDescription.en: Should place bait on its hook if I want to have a chance at catching anything.\n\nYou can sometimes find bugs by clearing areas.
CardDescription.ja: 何かを釣るチャンスを得るには、針に餌を付けたほうがいい。\n\n周囲を整えると、虫が見つかる場合がある。
